result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now exists as a second name for `updateLandscape`. The `cli` module compiles, but I didn't run any tests or run the command itself. That means I haven't checked that `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` writes `config.json` and `index.html`, or what `-help` prints.

- **`Commands.java`:** I added the `analyzeLandscape` name and a description saying it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in the no-argument usage overview, using the same options as `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`:** `run` sends `analyzeLandscape` to the same `updateLandscape(...)` method as `updateLandscape`. The only difference is the command name and description passed in. So the options and behaviour are identical, and `-help` prints the usage of whichever name was typed.
- **`README.md`:** it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape command" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape` and notes that `updateLandscape` still works.
